checksum.description: CRC32 checksum of (prefix + body) as a UTF-8 byte string, result encoded in Base62 using the charset '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', zero-padded to 6 characters (most significant digit first)
HMAC-SHA256 with key 'cap_signing_key_v1' (UTF-8 encoded), message is (prefix + body) as UTF-8, take first 8 characters of the lowercase hex digest

SHA-256 of (prefix + body) as a UTF-8 byte string, take the first 4 bytes as a big-endian unsigned 32-bit integer, encode in Base62 using the charset '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', zero-padded to 6 characters (most significant digit first)
